supported_fields.mechanics: Controllable short rush that spins the user with air warped around the body; current documentation records a four-hit rush and slight directional control.

limits: Current Fandom skill page currently displays Skill Shop as an obtained-from endpoint, conflicting with the maintained PQ85 evidence and Dragon Ball Wiki's PQ85 acquisition statement. The repository preserves PQ85 as the documented acquisition source because multiple independent PQ sources explicitly list Zigzag Express in PQ85 Basic Reward.
Male Majin usability restriction is supported; no additional form/timing/damage claims are promoted.
